text: The authors propose checkability training, an iterative algorithm inspired by the Prover-Verifier Game of Anil et al. They formulate a verifier-leading version of the game and say their algorithm follows that version while optimizing losses with better convergence properties in practice.
title: Kirchner et al. turn Anil et al.'s Prover-Verifier Game into checkability training for LLM provers
